supersedes: CURRENT_AFFINITY_TARGET as operationalized by G3 human SAME_PROCESS/DIFFERENT_PROCESS review under review_external_boundary_package.py (declared INVALID in G3_AFFINITY_TARGET_SEMANTICS_AUDIT_001)

biological_target.name: nearest_neighbor_object_affinity
biological_target.definition: For voxel v in ZYX integer array coordinates and axis a in {0,1,2}, let e_a be the unit step along axis a. Let S be a valid reference instance segmentation assigning each voxel an object id (0 = background/ignore). Then A(v,a) = 1 iff S(v) != 0 and S(v) == S(v+e_a); else A(v,a) = 0 when both voxels are inside the labeled domain; undefined/ignored when either voxel is outside the volume or marked ignore.
required_properties: invariant under any permutation π of axes when S and A are transformed consistently

observable_em_evidence.definition: Raw EM intensities (and optional derived image features) in a neighborhood of {v, v+e_a}. Evidence may correlate with A but is not A.
observable_em_evidence.forbidden_collapse: Do not treat local membrane appearance as identical to object identity.

annotation_procedure.definition: Any human or algorithmic procedure used to estimate A from evidence or from reference S.
annotation_procedure.validity_requirement: A procedure is valid only if its outputs are equivariant under axis permutation of the full presentation (geometry + context + display + controls) OR if labels are derived mechanically from a validated S.
annotation_procedure.failed_procedure: G3 interface-queue Napari review of SAME_PROCESS/DIFFERENT_PROCESS (008) — presentation not permutation-equivariant; target declared INVALID for training.

model_prediction.definition: A learned function Â(raw, v, a) approximating A.
model_prediction.forbidden_collapse: Model outputs are not biological truth; they require evaluation against biological_target or independent instance GT.

derivation_from_instance_segmentation.rule: If a validated instance volume S exists in the same crop and frame, affinities SHALL be computed by comparing S(v) and S(v+e_a) for each a; provenance MUST record S path, hash, frame id, and derivation code version.

evaluation_contract.permutation_equivariance: For any axis permutation π, metrics computed on A and on π(A) after transforming predictions/labels must match within numerical tolerance when the biological volumes are permuted.
evaluation_contract.identifiability: Training/evaluation must not use a label set that is a deterministic function of axis identity alone.
evaluation_contract.held_out: Never evaluate production claims on volumes whose labels were used for training or for UI debugging of the same decisions.

explicit_non_goals: Do not redefine A to match historical G3-008 labels
Do not treat orientation-collinear human labels as biological_target
Do not promote SAME_PROCESS decisions to MV-N / MV-SYN / MV-CONN
